headings.title: Parole and release upon duly adopted board order
headings.reviewNote: Requires all releases or paroles to issue upon a duly adopted order of the parole board (version in effect until 1-01-28 per Revisor's note).

headings.title: Risk assessment, personal interview, and release standard
headings.reviewNote: Requires validated risk/needs assessment and personal hearing panel interview (waivable unless victim requests hearing; videoconference discretionary), authorizes parole for society's best interest (not clemency or sentence reduction), and preserves department legal custody.

headings.title: Supervision fee authority, inmate fund deposit, and uses
headings.reviewNote: Grants the division of probation and parole discretionary authority to charge up to $60/month supervision fees, waive fees, sanction willful nonpayment, contract collections, deposit receipts in the section 217.430 inmate fund for collections or intervention services, and adopt rules.

headings.title: Parole eligibility and hearing rules; reciting conditions
headings.reviewNote: Requires the parole board to adopt rules under section 217.040 on parole eligibility, hearing conduct, and conditions, and requires every parole order to recite its conditions.

headings.title: Parole eligibility calculation for consecutive sentences
headings.reviewNote: Calculates minimum parole eligibility for consecutive sentences by adding each sentence's minimum term, capped at the minimum eligibility term for an ordinary life sentence.

headings.title: Parole eligibility after fifteen years for juvenile offenses
headings.reviewNote: Permits parole eligibility after fifteen years (regardless of appeal finality) and reconsideration hearings for offenders under age eighteen at the offense who received sentence(s) totaling fifteen or more years.

headings.title: Murder exceptions to juvenile fifteen-year eligibility
headings.reviewNote: Exempts under-18 offenders found guilty of capital murder, first degree murder, or section 565.021(1)(1) second degree murder from subsection 6, noting control by sections 558.047 or 565.033.

headings.title: Three-year wait after first degree murder parole denial
headings.reviewNote: Bars an offender sentenced for first degree murder who is denied parole from another hearing for at least three years, without preventing release under section 558.011(4).

headings.title: Notice to requesting victims of release assessment
headings.reviewNote: Requires notifying a victim who requested to be heard that the board is assessing release risk and readiness and that safety and protective-measure input is particularly helpful.

headings.title: Minimum parole hearing procedures and victim rights
headings.reviewNote: Establishes minimum hearing procedures: victim accompaniment, testimony with or without inmate present, call/write option, central-office board meeting, judge/prosecutor/police attendance or input, and section 211.425 juvenile sex offender registry review for ages 17–21.

headings.title: Notification of parole eligibility hearing results
headings.reviewNote: Requires the parole board to notify any person of parole eligibility hearing results if the person indicates a desire to be notified.

headings.title: Discretionary parole conditions and incarceration restitution
headings.reviewNote: Permits the parole board to impose parole conditions that are not illegal or impossible, which may include restitution to the state for incarceration costs.

headings.title: Special parole conditions and officer modifications
headings.reviewNote: Requires special conditions responsive to risk/needs or extraordinary supervision, rules minimizing low-risk conditions, frontloading, and reducing conditions for stability, and allowing parole officer modification with supervisor approval.

headings.title: Construction against mandatory release or sentence reduction
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that nothing in this section requires releasing an offender on parole or reduces a previously committed offender's sentence.

headings.title: High school diploma requirement and director waiver
headings.reviewNote: Beginning January 1, 2001, bars parole unless the offender obtained a high school diploma or equivalent or made an honest good-faith effort, subject to written director waiver for active mandatory education participation or academic inability.

headings.title: Chapter 536 rulemaking compliance and nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Conditions rule effectiveness on chapter 536 and section 536.028 compliance and declares this section nonseverable with chapter 536, voiding post-August 28, 2005 rulemaking authority and rules if legislative review powers are held unconstitutional.

entries.reviewSummary: Parole release orders (in effect until 1-01-28 per Revisor's note), risk assessments, supervision fees, rulemaking, consecutive/juvenile/murder eligibility, victim hearing procedures, conditions, education mandate, and chapter 536 nonseverability.

headings.title: Parole and release upon duly adopted board order
headings.reviewNote: Requires all releases or paroles to issue upon a duly adopted order of the parole board (effective 1-01-28, see § 1.901; severability § 1.1005).

headings.title: Risk assessment, personal interview, and release standard
headings.reviewNote: Requires validated risk/needs assessment and personal hearing panel interview (waivable unless victim requests hearing; videoconference discretionary), authorizes parole for society's best interest (not clemency or sentence reduction), and preserves department legal custody.

headings.title: Supervision fee authority, inmate fund deposit, and uses
headings.reviewNote: Grants the division of probation and parole discretionary authority to charge up to $60/month supervision fees, waive fees, sanction willful nonpayment, contract collections, deposit receipts in the section 217.430 inmate fund for collections or intervention services, and adopt rules.

headings.title: Parole eligibility and hearing rules; reciting conditions
headings.reviewNote: Requires the parole board to adopt rules under section 217.040 on parole eligibility, hearing conduct, and conditions, and requires every parole order to recite its conditions.

headings.title: Parole eligibility calculation for consecutive sentences

headings.title: Minimum percentage served for concurrent sentences
headings.reviewNote: Requires a person with court-imposed concurrent sentences to serve the minimum required percentage for the longest sentence prior to parole eligibility (added effective 1-01-28).

entries.reviewSummary: Delayed-effective (1-01-28) parole release standards, risk assessments, supervision fees, consecutive/concurrent/juvenile/murder eligibility, victim hearing procedures, conditions, education mandate, and chapter 536 nonseverability.

headings.title: Parole eligibility for domestic violence homicide victims
headings.reviewNote: Grants parole eligibility after fifteen years to offenders serving life without parole (or no parole for 50 years) with plea/trial before Dec. 31, 1990, for spouse/partner homicide with no prior violent felonies, no legal recourse, and corroborated unpresented domestic violence history.

headings.title: Thorough board review and written statement of reasons
headings.reviewNote: Requires the board to conduct a thorough case history review and provide a written statement of reasons for its parole determination.

headings.title: Supervision by probation and parole upon release
headings.reviewNote: Places offenders released under this section under the supervision of the division of probation and parole.

headings.title: Criteria considered by board in parole determinations
headings.reviewNote: Specifies statutory criteria considered by the board, including abuse documentation, prison record, age, and plea bargain history.

headings.title: Eligibility prior to fifteen years unaffected
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that provisions do not restrict parole eligibility or release determinations for offenders otherwise eligible before fifteen years.

headings.title: Executive clemency review powers of governor unaffected
headings.reviewNote: Affirms that section provisions do not restrict executive clemency reviews or the governor's constitutional pardon powers.

headings.title: Offender responsibility to petition for parole hearing
headings.reviewNote: Places the responsibility upon the incarcerated offender to petition the parole board for a special domestic violence parole hearing.

headings.title: Class D felony perjury penalty for false statements
headings.reviewNote: Designates knowingly making a false witness statement to the parole board under this section as class D felony perjury.

headings.title: Resolution of conflicting witness statements on abuse
headings.reviewNote: Requires other corroborative evidence when witness statements conflict on whether continual, substantial domestic violence occurred; a victim's contradictory statement is not a conflicting statement.

entries.reviewSummary: Special parole eligibility after fifteen years for domestic violence victims convicted of partner homicides, criteria, and perjury penalties.

headings.title: Definitions of chief law enforcement official and offender
headings.reviewNote: Defines chief law enforcement official, county, and offender for parole release registration requirements.

headings.title: Pre-release registration, photographs, and fingerprinting of offenders
headings.reviewNote: Requires supervised offenders prior to release to complete registration forms, submit to photographs, fingerprints, and identification procedures.

headings.title: Mandatory registration upon change in county of residence
headings.reviewNote: Requires offenders changing county of residence to register with the chief local law enforcement official within seven days.

headings.title: Parole revocation for failure to register residence
headings.reviewNote: Provides that failure to register changes of residence with law enforcement shall be cause for parole revocation absent good cause.

headings.title: Data recording in highway patrol criminal system
headings.reviewNote: Directs recording of initial registration and residence change data in the state highway patrol criminal information system.

headings.title: Department of public safety registration form design
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director of public safety to design and distribute registration forms and provide administrative coordination.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandatory law enforcement registration, photographs, fingerprints, and highway patrol recording for offenders released under parole supervision.

headings.title: Eligibility criteria for earned compliance credits
headings.reviewNote: Specifies offender eligibility criteria based on offense classification and supervision compliance.

headings.title: Ineligibility determination by sentencing court upon motion
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court or prosecutor motion finding an offender ineligible for compliance credits.

headings.title: Credit accrual rate and effective reduction
headings.reviewNote: Establishes thirty-day term reduction for each full calendar month of compliance.

headings.title: Definition of compliance for credit accrual
headings.reviewNote: Defines compliance as absence of initial violation reports or revocation motions.

headings.title: Suspension, accrual pause, and credit rescission
headings.reviewNote: Governs credit suspension during violations and rescission upon revocation or court finding.

headings.title: Absconder status precluding credit accrual
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits accrual of compliance credits while an offender is deemed an absconder.

headings.title: Final discharge upon credit satisfaction
headings.reviewNote: Requires final discharge once custody time, supervision time, and credits satisfy sentence.

headings.title: Prohibition of appeal or postconviction relief
headings.reviewNote: Precludes judicial appeals or postconviction motions regarding credit awards or rescissions.

headings.title: Semiannual calculation and offender notification
headings.reviewNote: Requires semiannual division recalculation and notification to offender of remaining supervision term.

headings.title: Advance notice before final discharge
headings.reviewNote: Requires sixty-day advance notice to court, board, and prosecutor prior to discharge.

headings.title: Continued eligibility for pre-2017 sentences
headings.reviewNote: Maintains credit eligibility for offenders sentenced prior to 2017 under original criteria.

headings.title: Suspension during treatment court participation
headings.reviewNote: Suspends credit accrual during treatment court and applies accumulated credits upon completion.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes earned compliance credits reducing probation and parole supervision terms for compliant eligible offenders.

headings.title: Appointment of probation and parole officers
headings.reviewNote: Directs division director to appoint probation, parole, and institutional officers.

headings.title: Investigation and supervision duties of officers
headings.reviewNote: Outlines officer duties to investigate, instruct offenders, and monitor conduct and condition.

headings.title: Modification of probation conditions by court
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes officer recommendations and court orders imposing or modifying probation conditions.

headings.title: Case records and record transfer duties
headings.reviewNote: Requires detailed work records and transfer of records when parolees change officers.

headings.title: Duties of institutional parole officers
headings.reviewNote: Directs institutional officers to investigate offenders and provide written parole conditions.

headings.title: Official credentials and badge requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires department to issue credentials and special badges carried on duty.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs appointment, investigations, supervision responsibilities, records, and badges of probation and parole officers.

headings.title: Authority to carry firearms and regulations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes certified officers and board members to carry firearms pursuant to regulations.

headings.title: Firearms safety and certification training
headings.reviewNote: Requires minimum sixteen hours of firearm safety and certification training.

headings.title: Department determination of firearm type
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to determine authorized firearm types carried by personnel.

headings.title: Officer purchase of firearm and holster
headings.reviewNote: Requires officers choosing to carry firearms to purchase their firearm and holster.

headings.title: Department provision of required ammunition
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to furnish ammunition necessary for official duties.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking procedures and nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Specifies statutory rulemaking procedures and nonseverability for firearm regulations.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes probation and parole officers and board members to carry firearms subject to training and regulations.

headings.title: Detention order as revocation alternative
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes officer to order jail detention as alternative to formal revocation proceedings.

headings.title: Duration limits on detention periods
headings.reviewNote: Limits initial detention to 48 hours and total annual detention to 360 hours (source footnote notes word 'and' appears after 'three hundred' in original rolls).

headings.title: Written violation report and hearing rights
headings.reviewNote: Requires written violation report, hearing rights advice, and court filing.

headings.title: Application of jail labor provisions
headings.reviewNote: Applies prisoner labor statutory provisions to offenders detained under this section.

headings.title: Credit for detention against sentence
headings.reviewNote: Credits detention time against prison or jail term if probation or parole is revoked.

headings.title: Reimbursement of facility detention costs
headings.reviewNote: Requires division reimbursement of county jail or institution costs at least $30/day per offender subject to appropriations, requires officer funding certification, and permits facility refusal for lack of funds or space.

headings.title: Effect of detention on revocation
headings.reviewNote: Precludes subsequent revocation for same incident after detention unless new crime discovered.

entries.reviewSummary: Provides alternative short-term jail detention for probation or parole violations in lieu of revocation.

headings.title: Arrest warrant for release violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes warrants and detention for parole or conditional release condition violations.

headings.title: Preliminary hearing and board determination
headings.reviewNote: Establishes right to preliminary hearing and board authority upon violation reports.

headings.title: Fugitive status and time calculation
headings.reviewNote: Deems unserved warrants as fugitive status and governs sentence time credit calculations.

headings.title: Arrest of out-of-state offenders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes arrest and detention of out-of-state offenders supervised under interstate compact.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs arrest warrants, preliminary hearings, fugitive status, and revocation procedures for parolees and conditional releasees.

headings.title: Probation officer arrest warrant authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes probation officer arrest warrants and detention upon probable cause of violation.

headings.title: Preliminary hearing on probation violations
headings.reviewNote: Provides right to preliminary hearing on alleged violations for detained probationers.

headings.title: Notice and report to sentencing court
headings.reviewNote: Requires immediate notice and written report to sentencing court for revocation hearing.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs probation officer arrest authority, preliminary hearings, and violation reporting to the sentencing court.

headings.title: Parole service counted as imprisonment
headings.reviewNote: Deems time served on parole as service of sentence up to maximum term.

headings.title: Final discharge order and certificate
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board final discharge order and certificate after minimum three years.

headings.title: Voter registration information upon discharge
headings.reviewNote: Mandates written notification of voter registration procedures upon final discharge.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates parole duration as imprisonment service, final discharge certificates, and voter registration notification.

headings.title: Lifetime supervision mandate for sex offenses
headings.reviewNote: Requires lifetime supervision by the division of probation and parole for designated offenses committed on or after Aug. 28, 2006, or Jan. 1, 2017 (source table notes 2014 S.B. 491 transfers: 566.212→566.211, 566.213→533.210 [sic], 568.080→573.200, 568.090→573.205).

headings.title: Definition of prior sex offender
headings.reviewNote: Defines prior sex offender based on a prior guilty plea or finding under chapter 566, section 568.020 (with sexual or deviate sexual intercourse), or section 568.045(1)(2).

headings.title: Scope of lifetime supervision requirement
headings.reviewNote: Applies lifetime supervision to probation, parole, conditional release, and full sentence releases.

headings.title: Mandatory electronic monitoring via GPS
headings.reviewNote: Requires continuous global positioning system or equivalent electronic monitoring.

headings.title: Termination of supervision at age sixty-five
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board termination of lifetime supervision at age sixty-five based on risk assessment.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking authority for supervision
headings.reviewNote: Grants division authority to promulgate rules governing lifetime supervision and monitoring.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates lifetime probation or parole supervision and GPS monitoring for designated felony sex offenders.

headings.title: Probation services upon court request
headings.reviewNote: Directs division to provide probation services upon request of circuit court judge.

headings.title: Eligible offense categories for probation services
headings.reviewNote: Restricts probation services to felonies and designated class A misdemeanor offenses.

entries.reviewSummary: Provision of probation services to circuit courts upon judge request for felonies and designated class A misdemeanors.

headings.title: Presentence investigation assignment upon court request
headings.reviewNote: Requires officer assignment upon circuit judge request for presentence investigations in felonies and specified class A misdemeanors, and requires an alternatives-to-incarceration report when section 558.019(7) (renumbered from 6 per footnote) recommends probation but the prosecutor does not (version until 1-01-28).

headings.title: Required contents of investigation report
headings.reviewNote: Specifies criminal record, social history, victim impact, and restorative justice options in report.

entries.reviewSummary: Presentence and preparole investigation assignments upon circuit judge request (in effect until 1-01-28 per Revisor's note), alternatives-to-incarceration reports, and required report contents.

headings.title: Presentence investigation assignment upon judge request
headings.reviewNote: Requires officer assignment upon sentencing judge request for presentence investigations in felonies and specified class A misdemeanors, and requires an alternatives-to-incarceration report when section 558.019(1) recommends probation but the prosecutor does not (effective 01-01-28, see § 1.901; severability § 1.1005).

headings.title: Required contents of investigation report
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required contents of presentence or preparole investigation reports, including criminal record, characteristics, financial/social history, victim impact, sentencing advisory commission recommendations, incarceration alternatives/restorative justice, and physical/mental examination when needed.

entries.reviewSummary: Delayed-effective (01-01-28) presentence and preparole investigation assignments upon sentencing judge request, alternatives-to-incarceration reports, and required report contents.

headings.title: Mandatory presentence investigation for felony injury
headings.reviewNote: Requires presentence investigation prior to sentencing for felonies causing serious injury or death.

headings.title: Victim impact statement inclusion requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires inclusion of victim impact statement if victim suffered injury or economic loss.

headings.title: Prosecutor preparation of victim impact statement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes prosecuting attorney victim impact statement if court dispenses with presentence investigation.

headings.title: Required contents of victim impact statement
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required items including victim identity, economic loss, injuries, and counseling requests.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates presentence investigations and victim impact statements for felony convictions resulting in injury or death.

headings.title: Administration and purposes of community corrections
headings.reviewNote: Establishes department administration of community corrections to encourage local sentencing alternatives.

headings.title: Scope of community restorative justice projects
headings.reviewNote: Outlines restorative justice projects including diversion, treatment, and community centers.

headings.title: Promulgation of program operational rules
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to promulgate rules and regulations for community corrections programs.

headings.title: Identification of local community needs
headings.reviewNote: Requires program development based on identified community needs and stakeholder consultation.

headings.title: Volunteer community boards and probation guidelines
headings.reviewNote: Establishes guidelines for volunteer community boards and five-year probation limits.

headings.title: Program staffing and contract authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department staffing or contracting with public and private agencies for delivery.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes community corrections programs, restorative justice alternatives, and local advisory board guidelines.

headings.title: Executive pardon authority and conditions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes governor to grant pardons subject to constitutional conditions and restrictions.

headings.title: Referral of clemency applications to board
headings.reviewNote: Requires referral of pardon applications to board for investigation and recommendation.

headings.title: Notice of executive clemency to repository
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to notify central criminal history repository of executive clemency actions.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs gubernatorial executive clemency, parole board investigation and reporting, and central repository notification.

headings.title: Authorization of interstate supervision compact
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes governor to execute interstate compact for cooperative probationer and parolee supervision.

headings.title: Text of interstate compact agreement
headings.reviewNote: Enacts full text of interstate compact governing out-of-state supervision and retaking.

headings.title: Compact severability and validity clause
headings.reviewNote: Establishes severability clause preserving remaining compact provisions if any part invalid.

headings.title: State payment of return expenses
headings.reviewNote: Directs state payment of proper expenses for retaking and returning persons to state.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Interstate Compact for the Supervision of Parolees and Probationers and provides for return expenses.

headings.title: Definition of exoneree for assistance
headings.reviewNote: Defines exoneree as a person whose conviction was overturned, vacated, set aside, or relieved of all legal consequences because evidence of innocence not presented at trial required reconsideration.

headings.title: Department assistance in obtaining identification documents
headings.reviewNote: Requires DOC to develop policies and assist exonerees in obtaining a birth certificate, Social Security card, and state ID prior to release, without delaying release for document delays.

headings.title: Post-release reentry services for exonerees
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department to provide released exonerees with reentry services available to offenders.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines exoneree and establishes department policies to provide identification documents and reentry assistance.

headings.title: Offense of unmanned aircraft overflight
headings.reviewNote: Defines unlawful drone operation within four hundred feet of secure perimeter fence.

headings.title: Facilities included within correctional center definition
headings.reviewNote: Defines correctional center to include state facilities, private jails, and municipal jails.

headings.title: Permitted unmanned aircraft operational exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts authorized staff, law enforcement, utilities, railroads, and FAA-waivered operators.

headings.title: Penalties and felony classification enhancements
headings.reviewNote: Classifies offense as infraction or felony when carrying weapons, drugs, or aiding escape.

headings.title: Conspicuous perimeter warning signage requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires correctional centers to post warning signs of minimum eleven by fourteen inches.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes offense of unlawful unmanned aircraft operation over correctional centers, exceptions, and penalties.

headings.title: Suspension of MO HealthNet benefits during incarceration
headings.reviewNote: Requires suspension in lieu of cancellation of MO HealthNet benefits while incarcerated.

headings.title: Department notice requirements to social services
headings.reviewNote: Mandates department notifications to social services upon offender entry and release.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires suspension rather than termination of MO HealthNet medical assistance during inmate incarceration.

headings.title: Establishment and purpose of nursery program
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Correctional Center Nursery Program, subject to appropriations, by July 1, 2025, for mother-child bonding up to 18 months post-delivery without modifying the inmate's custodial rights or creating department legal custody.

headings.title: Definitions for correctional nursery program
headings.reviewNote: Defines 'correctional center nursery program', 'department', 'public assistance', and 'support' (including child/spousal court-ordered support with 10% simple annual interest, third-party payments, and pregnancy/confinement expenses).

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes correctional center nursery program in women's facilities and defines statutory program terms.

headings.title: Inmate eligibility criteria for nursery program
headings.reviewNote: Sets eligibility criteria including custody delivery, release date window, and nonviolent offenses.

headings.title: Exclusive department classification authority over placement
headings.reviewNote: Vests placement decisions exclusively in department internal classification rather than courts.

headings.title: Department determination of program capacity
headings.reviewNote: Grants department exclusive authority to determine participant capacity of nursery program.

headings.title: Bar on child return after release
headings.reviewNote: Bars the child from returning to the program after first release of mother and child if the mother is revoked or receives a new assignment to DOC.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes eligibility criteria, classification authority, and capacity limits for correctional nursery program.

headings.title: Inmate written agreement requirements for nursery
headings.reviewNote: Requires written agreement to comply with nursery rules, healthcare enrollment, and placement.

headings.title: Department operational policies for nursery program
headings.reviewNote: Requires department to establish operational policies and guidelines for nursery program.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes inmate written agreement requirements and operational policy mandate for nursery program.

headings.title: Collection and deposit of child support
headings.reviewNote: Directs child support division to forward assigned payments for deposit into inmate banking.

headings.title: Acceptance of donations for nursery program
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department to accept monetary and property donations on behalf of nursery.

headings.title: Exclusive use of donations for program
headings.reviewNote: Restricts accepted donations solely to expenses of operating and maintaining nursery.

headings.title: Prohibition of property donations for individuals
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits property donations made on behalf of one specific incarcerated inmate or child.

headings.title: Financial support through inmate banking system
headings.reviewNote: Requires specific financial donations and public support to pass through inmate banking.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates collection of child support payments and receipt and use of donations for nursery program.

headings.title: Creation and administration of nursery fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes Correctional Center Nursery Program Fund in state treasury for program operation.

headings.title: Nonreversion of fund balance to general revenue
headings.reviewNote: Exempts unexpended nursery fund balances from biennial transfer to general revenue.

headings.title: Investment of fund moneys and interest
headings.reviewNote: Directs state treasurer to invest fund moneys and credit interest earnings to fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Creates dedicated Correctional Center Nursery Program Fund in state treasury and regulates investments.
